bugs.summary: The list is not filtered at all: the counter jumps from the normal open count to "12 Open" and every milestone of the repository is listed, although no milestone title or description contains a "%" character. Searching "_" does the same (returns every milestone). The page address becomes ?state=open&q=%25, so the character did reach the filter. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/milestones)
bugs.expected: The search should look for the literal character and list only the milestones whose title or description contains "%" — none of them, so an empty result list.
bugs.actual: The list is not filtered at all: the counter jumps from the normal open count to "12 Open" and every milestone of the repository is listed, although no milestone title or description contains a "%" character. Searching "_" does the same (returns every milestone). The page address becomes ?state=open&q=%25, so the character did reach the filter.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1
Open https://5503-iyzv7z1seljoi3fg0srip.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/milestones (7 milestones were listed at the time, none with a % in its name)

The result URL is /eval/harbor-handbook/milestones?state=open&q=%25 and the whole milestone list is returned

bugs.name: Closing a milestone from its detail page lands on a list of open milestones, and the closed milestone disappears from view
bugs.summary: The redirect goes to /eval/harbor-handbook/milestones?state=close, an address the app does not understand as "closed": the "Open" tab is the active one and the list shows open milestones only (every entry still has an "Edit / Close / Delete" action). The milestone that was just closed (agent8-close-state) is not in the list at all, so nothing on the page confirms the close. The Closed count in the tab did increase, but the closed milestone can only be seen after manually clicking the "Closed" tab. Reloading ?state=close keeps showing the open list. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/milestone/{id} → /eval/harbor-handbook/milestones?state=close)
bugs.expected: The user is taken to a list that shows the result of the action - the Closed list (or the milestone still visible with a "Reopen" action) - so they can confirm the milestone is now closed. The Open/Closed tabs agree with the list shown.
bugs.actual: The redirect goes to /eval/harbor-handbook/milestones?state=close, an address the app does not understand as "closed": the "Open" tab is the active one and the list shows open milestones only (every entry still has an "Edit / Close / Delete" action). The milestone that was just closed (agent8-close-state) is not in the list at all, so nothing on the page confirms the close. The Closed count in the tab did increase, but the closed milestone can only be seen after manually clicking the "Closed" tab. Reloading ?state=close keeps showing the open list.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1.
Go to /eval/harbor-handbook/milestones/new, type the title "agent8-close-state", a due date 2026-06-30, and click "Create Milestone".
On the milestones list, click the new milestone's title to open its detail page (e.g. /eval/harbor-handbook/milestone/13).
Click the "Close" button at the top right of the detail page.

bugs.expected: Clicking a repository name in 'In your repositories' should filter the milestone list to that repository only, highlight that repository, and list its milestones.
bugs.actual: The clicked repository is the one excluded: it loses its highlight and its milestones vanish from the list, while every other repository stays selected. With nothing selected yet, one click therefore shows all repositories except the one just clicked.
